role: already viewed development comparison; not held out

change: Replace only raw pair kernel; same frozen retained-information engine and all work/admission/keyframe/expiry bounds

factor.cell: floor, right-sided derivative at integer knots
factor.corner_requirements: all four measured depths and valid normals; 0.3<Z<5; max-min<=0.05+0.01*min
factor.projection: optical source to target, then continuous u,v
factor.jacobian: exact derivative of F with respect to target-camera query, including projective depth gradients
factor.metric_normalizer: norm(dF/dq) frozen per linearization; residual_m=F/normalizer; J_metric=(dF/dq)/normalizer
factor.distance_gate: query versus backprojected interpolated target: <0.12m scale4, <0.08m scales2/1
factor.robust: Huber 0.01m on normalized residual; min200 per pair
factor.prior: same incident-only Schur elimination and fixed-anchor transport; factor normalization frozen with marginalized linearization
